title: Data Mining Principles
content: Data mining involves discovering patterns in large data sets using association rules, Apriori algorithms, and FP-Growth frequent itemset mining.

title: Information Retrieval Systems
content: Information retrieval systems build inverted indexes and score documents using TF-IDF and Okapi BM25 probabilistic retrieval models.

title: MapReduce and Distributed Systems
content: HDFS provides fault-tolerant storage while MapReduce and Apache Spark enable large-scale distributed data processing and stream analytics.

title: Dense Retrieval and RAG
content: Hybrid search combines BM25 sparse retrieval with dense vector embeddings using FAISS and RRF fusion for RAG systems.
